title: identity/v1 JWT payload
description: The claims of every token NewAPI's identity plugin issues (header: alg ES256, typ at+jwt, kid). The schema checks shape only; signature, iss, aud, time and lifetime rules are in README.md ("Verifying"). Unknown claims are allowed and must be ignored (C2: new optional claims are additive).

iss.description: The issuer: the NewAPI base URL of the environment. Verifiers compare it exactly and fetch keys from <iss>/.well-known/jwks.json.

sub.description: Who calls: a NewAPI account (acc_<id>) or a service token's service (svc_<layer>: svc_ecs, svc_agentspace, svc_agentevents, svc_agentcompute, svc_agenthost), issued to that layer for one tenant and owner; the layer exchanges it for narrowed child tokens per run or attempt (sub stays svc_<layer>).

ten.description: Tenant: the account that buys the layer. In our own product the tenant is ECS's account and the product's users are owners inside it.

own.description: Owner: whose resources these are (devices, spaces, conversations).

pay.description: Payer: whose quota this usage is booked to (metering/v1 records carry it unchanged).

aud.description: The one layer this token is for. A single string, never an array: a token for two layers is two tokens.

scp.description: Scope entries <kind>:<id>:<right>. A ceiling, not a grant: the layer still checks its own data for what `own` may do (authorisation stays in the layers).

run.description: Optional: the run (conversation id) this token acts for. Present = a run token, lifetime at most 900 s.

exp.description: Expires at, Unix seconds. exp - iat <= 3600, and <= 900 when `run` is present.

jti.description: Unique token id (lowercase UUID); logs and revocation lists name it.

account.description: A NewAPI account id, acc_<native user id>.

scope.description: <kind>:<id>:<right>. v1 kinds and rights: space:<spc_id>:ro|rw (rw implies ro), space:new:create (create a space; its owner is the token's own), computer:<cmp_id>:ssh, conversation:<cnv_id>:send|read|children (children: a run managing its own sub-Agents), conversation:new:create (create a conversation; its owner is the token's own). A layer's contract may add kinds and rights (additive). id is a resource id, `new` for create, or * (every existing resource of that kind `own` may use; never `new`). The only implication between rights is rw -> ro.
